content.policy: Full source items with inherited branch context, and complete numbered equipment-location lists bound by native line baselines. Table/image-only content is audited separately.

native-table.policy: Native spatial table association. Merged cells are bound by their actual row-spanning rectangles. Training row questions assess all six checked/blank programme columns together.

image-table.policy: Every transcribed row and nonblank location/quantity/MEL entry is read against the original raster table. Blank MEL cells are not interpreted as Nil. DGR merged forbidden/on-person rows retain their merged meaning.

image-rule.policy: Manually transcribed complete image-only entries with original page images. Short numerical questions retain the complete entry and identify the exact blank.

auditScope: All 667 pages inventoried; every learning-content page and numbered leaf section has questions. Full source items, equipment location lists, table associations, merged cells, training tick sets and manually transcribed image-only steps have separate checks.
limitations: Question count and section/page coverage do not prove that each separate fact has its own question, or that a learner has mastered the SOP.
Native text-unit gaps include headings, figure captions, table-layout fragments, appendix question stems and original non-English command translations. These are not fabricated into filler questions.

Images were inspected as page overviews, and image-only facts used in questions were read at original resolution. Not every image label or diagram coordinate has an individual question. The low-resolution UPK thumbnail on PDF 166 is retained in the manual; unreadable small text is not guessed.
Full original manual remains available for every section and citation. Correct image transcriptions rely on human review, not automated text-layer proof.
